crossRefs.note: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.
Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by…
Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.
You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.

translations.web: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
translations.bsb: My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.
translations.kjv: Hold up my goings in thy paths, that my footsteps slip
translations.asv: My steps have held fast to thy paths, My feet have not slipped.
